say:1:1735805001:1.text: You haven't been in this territory before, so you might not know the situation.
say:1:1735805001:1.source_cn: 尊敬的狼王，你之前不在这片领地活动，应该不清楚这里的情况。
say:1:1735805001:1.male: You haven't been in this territory before, so you might not know the situation.
say:1:1735805001:1.female: You haven't been in this territory before, so you might not know the situation.

say:2:1735805002:1.text: Though the forests are lush and the prey is fat... those awful two-legs are always invading our home!
say:2:1735805002:1.source_cn: 这片领地虽然森林茂盛、猎物肥美……但总有可恶的两脚兽来...
say:2:1735805002:1.male: Though the forests are lush and the prey is fat... those awful two-legs are always invading our home!
say:2:1735805002:1.female: Though the forests are lush and the prey is fat... those awful two-legs are always invading our home!

say:3:1735805003:1.text: They come to hunt all the time.
say:3:1735805003:1.source_cn: 总有两脚兽时不时来捕猎——
say:3:1735805003:1.male: They come to hunt all the time.
say:3:1735805003:1.female: They come to hunt all the time.

say:4:1735805004:1.text: But they're terrible at it! They scare away all the prey and leave us starving!
say:4:1735805004:1.source_cn: 他们捕猎技巧很烂！抓不到猎物，只会把猎物全都吓跑！让我...
say:4:1735805004:1.male: But they're terrible at it! They scare away all the prey and leave us starving!
say:4:1735805004:1.female: But they're terrible at it! They scare away all the prey and leave us starving!

say:5:1735805005:1.text: And then there are the strong ones like just now. They don't hunt prey, they hunt us!
say:5:1735805005:1.source_cn: 还有像刚刚那样厉害的两脚兽。他们不捕猎，但他们抓狼！
say:5:1735805005:1.male: And then there are the strong ones like just now. They don't hunt prey, they hunt us!
say:5:1735805005:1.female: And then there are the strong ones like just now. They don't hunt prey, they hunt us!

say:6:1735805006:1.text: We used to live peacefully in this cave... but they must be out of their minds. They want to take our territory!
say:6:1735805006:1.source_cn: 以前我们还能住在这个山洞，躲个清静。结果，那群两脚兽不...
say:6:1735805006:1.male: We used to live peacefully in this cave... but they must be out of their minds. They want to take our territory!
say:6:1735805006:1.female: We used to live peacefully in this cave... but they must be out of their minds. They want to take our territory!

say:7:1735805007:1.text: It's bad enough the idiots scare off the food, but now the strong ones are taking our home! Can't we at least have a place to live?
say:7:1735805007:1.source_cn: 猎物总被笨蛋两脚兽吓跑已经很惨了，现在家也要被厉害两脚...
say:7:1735805007:1.male: It's bad enough the idiots scare off the food, but now the strong ones are taking our home! Can't we at least have a place to live?
say:7:1735805007:1.female: It's bad enough the idiots scare off the food, but now the strong ones are taking our home! Can't we at least have a place to live?

narration:8:1735805008:1.text: The wolves howl in grief and indignation.
narration:8:1735805008:1.male: The wolves howl in grief and indignation.
narration:8:1735805008:1.female: The wolves howl in grief and indignation.

narration:9:1735805009:1.text: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...
narration:9:1735805009:1.male: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...
narration:9:1735805009:1.female: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...

choice_prompt:10:1735805009.text: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...
choice_prompt:10:1735805009.source_cn: 狼吼滚石一样在山洞石壁上来回撞击，如同深渊咆哮般震耳欲聋……
choice_prompt:10:1735805009.male: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...
choice_prompt:10:1735805009.female: Their howls bounce off the cave walls like rolling thunder, like roars from the abyss...

say:13:1735805011:1.text: Esteemed leader, please lead us to reclaim our home!
say:13:1735805011:1.source_cn: 尊敬的狼王啊，请你带领我们夺回自己的家园吧！
say:13:1735805011:1.male: Esteemed leader, please lead us to reclaim our home!
say:13:1735805011:1.female: Esteemed leader, please lead us to reclaim our home!

say:14:1735805012:1.text: Even if we can't drive the two-legs out entirely... at least get our cave back so we have a place to live!
say:14:1735805012:1.source_cn: 就算不能把这些可恨的两脚兽彻底赶出去，至少……至少把山...
say:14:1735805012:1.male: Even if we can't drive the two-legs out entirely... at least get our cave back so we have a place to live!
say:14:1735805012:1.female: Even if we can't drive the two-legs out entirely... at least get our cave back so we have a place to live!

say:15:1735805013:1.text: You find yourself in a dilemma. You aren't a real wolf; you can't exactly stay transformed and run amok in the hunting grounds forever.
say:15:1735805013:1.source_cn: 你一时左右为难。你又不是一只真正的狼，总不能维持着变形...
say:15:1735805013:1.male: You find yourself in a dilemma. You aren't a real wolf; you can't exactly stay transformed and run amok in the hunting grounds forever.
say:15:1735805013:1.female: You find yourself in a dilemma. You aren't a real wolf; you can't exactly stay transformed and run amok in the hunting grounds forever.

say:16:1735805014:1.text: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...
say:16:1735805014:1.source_cn: 但眼前的三只狼悲愤欲绝，大有你不答应就哭死在山洞里，或...
say:16:1735805014:1.male: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...
say:16:1735805014:1.female: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...

choice_prompt:17:1735805014.text: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...
choice_prompt:17:1735805014.source_cn: 但眼前的三只狼悲愤欲绝，大有你不答应就哭死在山洞里，或是用悲吼声把你耳朵震聋的趋势……
choice_prompt:17:1735805014.male: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...
choice_prompt:17:1735805014.female: But the wolves before you are utterly desperate. It seems they might cry themselves to death in this cave, or howl until your ears bleed unless you agree...

say:18:1735805015:1.text: In the animal world, wolves fight with fang and claw. But in human society, people fight with words.
say:18:1735805015:1.source_cn: 在动物世界，狼用爪与牙战斗。但在人类社会，人则用口舌与...
say:18:1735805015:1.male: In the animal world, wolves fight with fang and claw. But in human society, people fight with words.
say:18:1735805015:1.female: In the animal world, wolves fight with fang and claw. But in human society, people fight with words.

say:19:1735805016:1.text: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.
say:19:1735805016:1.source_cn: 狼们只是想拿回山洞的居住权。或许你可以找到一个合适的理...
say:19:1735805016:1.male: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.
say:19:1735805016:1.female: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.

choice_prompt:20:1735805016.text: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.
choice_prompt:20:1735805016.source_cn: 狼们只是想拿回山洞的居住权。或许你可以找到一个合适的理由，劝服守备军自愿停止对狼的驱赶……
choice_prompt:20:1735805016.male: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.
choice_prompt:20:1735805016.female: The wolves only want their home back. Perhaps you can convince the guards to stop driving them out.

say:21:1735805017:1.text: Leader, are we going into battle? I want to fight by your side!
say:21:1735805017:1.source_cn: 狼王，你要战斗了吗！我也想和你一起战斗！
say:21:1735805017:1.male: Leader, are we going into battle? I want to fight by your side!
say:21:1735805017:1.female: Leader, are we going into battle? I want to fight by your side!

say:22:1735805018:1.text: No, you're too small. You'll just get in the way!
say:22:1735805018:1.source_cn: 不行，你太小，只会给狼王拖后腿！
say:22:1735805018:1.male: No, you're too small. You'll just get in the way!
say:22:1735805018:1.female: No, you're too small. You'll just get in the way!

say:23:1735805019:1.text: Great King, we await your command.
say:23:1735805019:1.male: Great King, we await your command.
say:23:1735805019:1.female: Great Queen, we await your command.

say:24:1735805020:1.text: We'll be waiting for the good news!
say:24:1735805020:1.source_cn: 狼王，我们等你的好消息！
say:24:1735805020:1.male: We'll be waiting for the good news!
say:24:1735805020:1.female: We'll be waiting for the good news!

narration:25:1735805021:1.text: You leave the cave under the eager gaze of the wolf pack...
narration:25:1735805021:1.male: You leave the cave under the eager gaze of the wolf pack...
narration:25:1735805021:1.female: You leave the cave under the eager gaze of the wolf pack...

choice:20:1:2.text: Find a place to hide for a while.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 这段时间你们先找地方藏起来
choice:20:1:2.male: Find a place to hide for a while.
choice:20:1:2.female: Find a place to hide for a while.

choice:17:0:1.text: Wait, but I'm not the alpha wolf.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 等等，都说了我不是狼王
choice:17:0:1.male: Wait, but I'm not the alpha wolf.
choice:17:0:1.female: Wait, but I'm not the alpha wolf.

choice:17:1:2.text: Why does this have to be solved the "wolf" way?
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 为什么一定要用狼的方式解决？
choice:17:1:2.male: Why does this have to be solved the "wolf" way?
choice:17:1:2.female: Why does this have to be solved the "wolf" way?
